title: $40 a week is a key. It can’t spend $41.
slide_intent: Show how a recurring instruction becomes a bounded allowance so a visitor can inspect the terms before delegating a purchase.
strategic_value: The $40/$41 contrast gives a visitor a memorable boundary to look for in the interface.
demonstration: A configured key shows its allowance, operation, venue, expiry and the instruction in the owner’s words. The mockup illustrates the configured limit. It does not show an attempted $41 spend.
practical_value: Use this panel to match a natural-language request to the fields a person can inspect before trusting a recurring action.

content_islands.name: Headline field
content_islands.spec: On a near-white ground, set the first sentence on one line and the second directly beneath. Follow with “Write a limit in plain words. The chain holds it.”

content_islands.name: Key overview
content_islands.spec: Align a centered, cropped black-rimmed phone with the adjacent panels. Beneath the Key navigation title, enlarge the blue dot field with four outlined sockets. Center “Weekly SOL buy” and the blue $40 remaining amount below.

content_islands.name: Terms
content_islands.spec: Use a rounded white block with four divided rows. Pair What, How much, Where and Until with “Buy SOL, swap only”, “$40 a week”, “Jupiter” and “31 Mar 2027”.

content_islands.name: Owner’s instruction
content_islands.spec: Below the terms, label the text “In your words” and quote the request to buy $40 of SOL on Jupiter every Friday until the end of March. Let the Pause key control meet the lower crop.
